main_body: wooden coal bin filled with coal
top_band: dark grey/black coal mound and brown rim from rows 3 to 10 (bin rim rows 5-10)
evidence: The wooden bin shows a clear 3/4 top opening (rows 5-10) with side and front rims, heaped with coal (rows 3-9), above a 5-row vertical front face (rows 11-15) with a lighter front rim at row 10, dark shadow at row 11, and recessed panel on rows 12-14.

style.evidence: The coal pile is an almost solid near-black blob (7x5 flat fill with only 2 stray grey dots and a two-tone edge) and the wooden bin uses only 3 flat brown steps with no wood grain or chunk texture, much flatter and simpler than the Beodeul reference props.
